Removed a fabricated STATIC_TRIGGERED ON_DEFEND -> INTIMIDATE ability: the card has no intimidate text. The generator hallucinated it from Blade Break equipment (27 cards corpus-wide). The graveyard clause was a plain STATIC, which nothing dispatches, though the effect it needed (MAY_DESTROY_SILVERS_TO_EQUIP) and the trigger it needed (START_OF_TURN_IN_GRAVEYARD, dispatched to the active player's graveyard) both already existed. Its IN_GRAVEYARD and IS_ACTIVE_PLAYER conditions are dropped because that trigger already means both.

The equip clause tested NOT(IN_GRAVEYARD), which is TRUE even when the card is equipped FROM the graveyard -- by the time ON_EQUIP fires it has already left. 'From anywhere other than your graveyard' is about where it CAME FROM, so it is PLAYED_FROM_ZONE, which now falls back to prev_zone because equipping is not playing and never stamps played_from_zone.
